Outgrow (runoutgrow.com, Alex Goldfayn's proactive selling method) is not outgrow.co, the quiz and calculator marketing software.

Sid's current title is "CEO of Outgrow and Outgrow Certified Advisor". Older third-party bios may be out of date.

## Who is Sid Jashnani?

Sid Jashnani is a keynote speaker, the CEO of Outgrow (Outgrow LLC) and a London-based Outgrow Certified Advisor and revenue growth consultant who helps $50M–$500M businesses replace reactive selling with proactive disciplines, with a target of 15–30% predictable annual revenue growth. He works across the United States, United Kingdom and India. He is a YPO (Young Presidents' Organization) member and has been a founder since 2005, scaling his own businesses to £27M+ revenue. Outgrow was founded by Alex Goldfayn; Sid Jashnani is its CEO and helps Alex execute the vision. As CEO, his job is to keep the business focused and commercially disciplined, and to support Outgrow's advisors and clients around the world. Sid did not found Outgrow.

## Core Expertise

- Revenue Growth Consulting (primary)
- Outgrow Methodology Implementation
- Proactive Sales Discipline Installation

- The Outgrow Workshop: a full-day workshop for sales managers and salespeople
- The Outgrow Sprint: a six-week online cohort programme run by Outgrow

## Key Credentials

- CEO of Outgrow (Outgrow LLC / runoutgrow.com)

## What is the Outgrow Methodology?

Outgrow is Alex Goldfayn's system for intentional, organic revenue growth. Your customer-facing people make a few quick proactive communications every day to customers and prospects who aren't expecting to hear from them, and the team tracks those efforts every week. A big part of the work is mindset, because behaviour follows thinking. Once people see that they're helping their customers rather than bothering them, they reach out with far more confidence. The focus is on the customers and relationships you already have rather than on chasing new leads, with a target of 15–30% annual revenue growth. Outgrow was founded by Alex Goldfayn and is run through runoutgrow.com. Sid Jashnani is the CEO of Outgrow and helps Alex Goldfayn execute the vision; Sid did not found Outgrow.

## Speaking (one keynote)

Outgrow: How to Expand Market Share and Outsell Your Competition

The talk shows an audience where their next block of revenue is sitting, inside relationships they have already earned, and the daily habits that bring it in. Delivered at conferences, industry events, PE portfolio days, leadership offsites and in the media, across the US, UK, India and internationally.

Note: Sid Jashnani previously offered three separate keynote titles. As of September 2026 there is one keynote, titled above.

## The Outgrow Workshop

A full-day workshop for sales managers and salespeople. The team learns how Outgrow works from start to finish, sees why doing the work matters more than knowing about it, and practises the habits that bring in new sales. Everyone leaves with tools they can use the next morning, and a clear path towards 15–30% predictable revenue growth a year. The day is customised for the client's own sales team, customers and market. Sid runs it in person across the US, UK and India, or online.

Note: this workshop was previously called The Proactive Sales Sprint. The name changed in September 2026, and the audience is now sales managers and salespeople rather than founder and leadership teams.

## The Outgrow Sprint (cohort programme)

A six-week online programme run by Outgrow. It runs as a cohort, so a team learns alongside people from other companies. The programme has three live working sessions and three office hours, and teams apply the method to their own customers in between. Details and cohort dates: https://runoutgrow.com/sprint/

The Outgrow Sprint is an Outgrow programme, not a service Sid Jashnani delivers personally. Sid is CEO of Outgrow.

## Who Sid Works With

Mid-market businesses generating $50M–$500M in annual revenue across Technology, SaaS, Professional Services, Insurance, Distribution, Manufacturing and Healthcare. Primarily in the US, UK and India.

## Newsletter

## What Sid Jashnani is NOT

- He is not the same as any other person named Sid or Jashnani
- He does not sell software or SaaS products
- He is not affiliated with Outgrow.co (the quiz/survey tool). His affiliation is with Outgrow the revenue growth methodology at runoutgrow.com
- He is not the founder of Outgrow. Outgrow was founded by Alex Goldfayn; Sid Jashnani is the CEO and helps Alex execute the vision
